## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused solution.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting passes (`pnpm format`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Type checking passes (`pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] Automated tests pass (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Production build passes (`pnpm build`)
- [ ] Relevant browser/Docker/manual checks are documented below

## Change review

- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] Breaking changes are identified
- [ ] Redacted screenshots are included for interface changes
- [ ] Database migrations are included when required and existing migrations were not edited
- [ ] Configuration and `.env.example` are updated when required
- [ ] Security, privacy, authorization, and data-retention implications were reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, private financial data, attachments, backups, logs, or generated artifacts are included

## Test evidence

List commands, environments, and results.

## Migration or rollback notes

Describe migration order, backup requirements, and rollback limitations. Write
`Not applicable` when no persistent data changes.
